body:
## Commercial plot categories

Compare shopping centers, commercial Markaz, boulevard, commercial plots by area range, mixed-use plots, apartment plots, hotels, educational institutes, hospitals and filling stations. The rate table shows listed floors and per-square-yard rates by plot type.

## Application and payment options

The schedule lists 25% down payment at application, followed by 48 monthly installments over four years. It also lists a 15% special discount for lump-sum payment with application, or a 6% special discount with 50% payment at application. Ask which option applies to your selected category and request the full written payment schedule.

## Registration and additional charges

Registration is PKR 60,000 and non-refundable according to the schedule. Development charges are included in the stated plot cost except Sui Gas. Boulevard-facing plots along 100 to 350 ft roads carry a 5% additional cost. Confirm the exact calculation, taxes and all applicable charges in an itemized quotation.

## Specifications and possession

Floor count and plot specifications are subject to the relevant building by-laws and authority requirements. The schedule states physical possession follows completion of development work and 100% payment. Confirm the applicable terms for the exact plot in writing.

## Get a commercial plot shortlist

Share your preferred category, plot size, corner preference and budget. We can help you request current availability, a marked location and the complete payable amount.

faqsText:
What is the effective date of the commercial rate schedule? | The supplied schedule is effective 02 November 2026. Confirm current rates and availability before proceeding.
Are rates different for corner plots? | Yes. The schedule lists separate corner and non-corner rates for most categories; some categories have a corner rate only.
What payment terms are listed? | The schedule lists 25% down payment and 48 monthly installments over four years. It also lists a 15% special discount with lump-sum payment and a 6% special discount with 50% payment at application. Confirm applicable written terms.
What charges are included? | Development charges are included except Sui Gas. Registration is PKR 60,000 and non-refundable. A 5% additional cost applies to boulevard-facing plots on 100 to 350 ft roads.
How do I check the exact commercial location? | Ask for the category, plot number and location marked on a current commercial plan, then confirm its rate and complete payable amount.
